findings.title: C8-M01 regression test remains green when the guarded defect class or unrelated tooling failure is introduced
findings.root_cause: The regression accepts any non-zero process exit and infers destination safety only from absence of a fixed forbidden-string list. It does not positively prove that the production design-time Npgsql connection-required path was reached or that the destination remained unconfigured.
evidence: Judge A and Judge B independently reproduced an off-blocklist fabricated destination such as Host=db;Database=ambient_fallback while the committed regression remained green.
Judge A and Judge B independently reproduced a factory-unreachable build/tooling failure while the committed regression remained green.
Unmodified production Head was independently observed to fail closed with no configured destination; the Major concerns regression assurance, not a current production behavior defect.
findings.required_fix: Strengthen the test with positive assertions proving the intended production design-time/Npgsql connection-required path was reached and failed because no destination was configured. Ensure arbitrary build/tool/MSBuild failures cannot satisfy the test. Keep the destination blocklist only as supplementary evidence.

findings.title: Coincident 60-second command and whole-operation budgets couple the published exit taxonomy to an implicit ordering margin
findings.root_cause: Npgsql CommandTimeout and the whole-operation CTS use the same nominal deadline while exception type determines exit 1 versus exit 2.
findings.note: The stricter sub-claim that provider timeout necessarily can win the race is not part of Gold because Judge A/B differed on that reachability detail.

findings.title: PR body mislabels merge-ref CI as exact direct-head CI
evidence: Run 31350916189 checks out d12de2ae... PR merge ref.
Run 31350870902 checks out exact Head 99cee438... and succeeds.

findings.title: Ordinary failure exit-code taxonomy is not pinned by negative tests
findings.note: Judge A rated this Nit and Judge B rated it Minor. Gold uses Minor because the README exposes the 0/1/2 taxonomy as a deployment-facing contract, while still treating it as nonblocking.
